name: medusa-mcp
description: Run your Medusa v2 store – orders, payments, returns, products, inventory, promotions – with sales and restock dashboards.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Medusa v2 Admin API. Read orders, customers, products and stock; get sales, customer and restock analytics with interactive dashboards; and – when read-only is off – fulfill and ship orders, record payments and refunds, handle returns and order edits, create draft orders, manage products, catalog, promotions and price lists, and make bulk changes with a preview first. Includes ready-made prompts (store briefing, restock plan, monthly report…). The API key stays on your computer.

backend_url.title: Medusa backend URL
backend_url.description: URL of your Medusa backend, e.g. https://api.example.com

api_key.title: Secret API key
api_key.description: Medusa Admin → Settings → Developer → Secret API Keys (starts with sk_)

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Only register read and report tools. Turn off to allow fulfilling, refunding, editing products, promotions and more.

report_timezone.title: Reporting timezone
report_timezone.description: IANA timezone for date filters and report buckets, e.g. Europe/Prague
